key_insight: The Deep Algebraic Reynolds Stress Model (DARSM) successfully addresses the closure problem in RANS simulations using a physics-informed deep learning approach.
engineering_relevance: DARSM enables accurate turbulence predictions across varying Reynolds numbers and geometries while significantly improving computational efficiency.
method: Deep learning model trained on small datasets to derive algebraic Reynolds stress closures.
Utilizes adjoint equations for efficient end-to-end optimisation under implicit-explicit solver structure.
Generalises effectively to different flow regimes without the need for retraining.
evidence_signal: DARSM achieves a reduction in average test velocity error over baseline RANS by 2-4 times across multiple scenarios.
watch_item: The reliance on implicit-explicit solver structures may induce challenges in implementation and optimization.
paper_title: Deep Learning-based Algebraic Reynolds Stress Closures for RANS Simulations of Turbulent Flows
